Restored fine-grained persisted queries now preserve their full observable query state across `@tanstack/query-core`, `@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`, and the framework adapters.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Persister Restore Marker (`@tanstack/query-core`)**
   - Added and exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L167-L185) (along with [`PersisterRestoreInput`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L133-L136) and [`PersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L138-L141) in [types.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/types.ts) and [index.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/index.ts)), which is also re-exported by the framework adapters.
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L645-L674) and [`#restoreStateFromPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L731-L824) to detect restored snapshot markers returned by a `persister`, adopt the provided `state` with `fetchStatus: 'idle'` (preserving `status`, `error`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`, `dataUpdateCount`, `errorUpdateCount`, `fetchFailureCount`, `fetchFailureReason`, `fetchMeta`, `isInvalidated`, and infinite query `pages`/`pageParams`), and skip `QueryCache` `onSuccess`/`onSettled` fetch callbacks.

2. **Observer Mount & Result Preservation (`@tanstack/query-core` & `@tanstack/vue-query`)**
   - Updated [`QueryObserver`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L317-L779) (`shouldLoadOnMount`, `shouldFetchOnMount`, `shouldFetchOptionally`, `createResult`, and `updateResult`) so queries restored with persisted error/refetch-error metadata, failure counts, timestamps, or invalidation markers are exposed accurately through observer results without resetting `failureCount`/`failureReason` or forcing an immediate mount fetch when `refetchOnRestore` is disabled.
   - Updated [`useBaseQuery`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L140-L152) in `@tanstack/vue-query` so observer subscriptions are still registered when a core `QueryClient` instance without `isRestoring` is provided.

3. **Fine-Grained Persister & Bulk Reconciliation (`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core`)**
   - Updated [`experimental_createQueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L221-L545) so `persisterFn` returns [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L167-L185) when restoring from storage (unless `refetchOnRestore: 'always'` or inline refetching is triggered) and persists/restores full query state in [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L279-L361).
   - Added [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L78-L212) to independently merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) when restoring over an existing in-memory query.

4. **Tests**
   - Added unit and integration tests in [query.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx), [createPersister.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts), [react-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [preact-query/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx), [vue-query/useQuery.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/vue-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.ts), [solid-query/useQuery.test.tsx](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/solid-query/src/__tests__/useQuery.test.tsx), [angular-query-experimental/inject-query.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/angular-query-experimental/src/__tests__/inject-query.test.ts), and [svelte-query/createQuery.svelte.test.ts](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-oy7r5i5g/packages/svelte-query/tests/createQuery.svelte.test.ts).
